test_title: PYST 2: SSC JE ME- General Intelligence (Held On 09 Oct 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Ritu starts from point A and drives 9 km towards South. From here, she takes a left turn and drives 8 km. She then takes a left turn, drives 3 km, turns left and drives 12 km. Finally, she takes aright turn, drives 6 km and stops at point B. How far and in which direction is point B from point A?
solution: According to the given information, 1) Ritu starts from point A and drives 9 km towards South. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ad1d55d16eb6858d24ffaa99cb2cfceead28b2b385743ccccd1f66f626870dff.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5476124742b1a44d96ee9880d3025fa338436b739295134cabb5f3a69ce214a8.png] 2) From here, she takes a left turn and drives 8 km.
